items.quote: Interested Consultants shall provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the assignment, including an updated Curriculum Vitae (CV) with a description of experience in similar assignments and a brief cover letter.
A university degree in economics, entrepreneurship, management, international development, sociology, finance, or another relevant field.
At least five (5) years of demonstrated professional experience in entrepreneurship development, livelihood support, small business development, adult training, or development project implementation;
At least three (3) years of experience in Tajikistan in supporting entrepreneurship and/or the private sector;
Experience working with government authorities, private sector organizations, local communities, and development partners.
knowledge of English will be an advantage
Proficiency in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and reporting tools.
setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest
A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Individual Consultant selection method

Expressions of interest, including CV and cover letter, may be submitted in English, Russian, or Tajik and must be submitted to the e-mail address below on or before 16:00 hours local time on October 26, 2026.
The submitted documents, including the CV and cover letter, should be concise and must not exceed ten (10) pages in total.
The Specialist will work full-time at the Project Implementation Group (PIG) office at SCISPM in Dushanbe, with regular field visits to the Project’s target districts.
